added_response_propositions: המכתב מדווח כי הרבי הריי״צ לקח אליו את טיוטת מאמר י״ט כסלו כדי להוסיף ולתקן אותה, ובהמשך מסר לכותב האיגרת הוראה לפרסם יחד את דברי י״ח אלול וי״ט כסלו; הכותב מציין שהרשימות טרם נמסרו בחזרה, אף שרובן כבר הושלמו. ההוראה מיוחסת במפורש לריי״צ, ולא לכותב האיגרת.

limitations: Nine new sources remain Parsed because only bounded body passages were inspected; full source context, incoming correspondence, manuscripts or audio were not independently checked.
AID 4645969 is marked by the publisher as from the Rebbe's handwriting, but the autograph itself was not inspected; the printed date is preserved as published and not normalized.
AID 2987732 quotes a letter by the Previous Rebbe; the quoted statement is not attributed to the Rebbe as author.
AIDs 1695044 and 2126206 are secondary retrospective testimonies, not primary transcripts of the Rebbe's words.
Twelve candidate pages did not expose readable item-level body text and were excluded.
No new Yiddish body was accessible in this run; the corpus's earlier Yiddish material remains in its existing Evidence Families.

The volume XIII scan/index for ד׳תרפא verifies bibliographic identity and printed-page location only; it does not verify letter content, signature or wording. The earlier content propositions were removed.
note: Nine new AID identities, one existing AID enriched in place, two existing identities rechecked. The public 403/summary-shell path was not retried through the crawler; alternative accessible publisher pages and the permitted user PDF were used. The volume XIII scan-only item was corrected to metadata-only; its prior three propositions no longer count. Corrected post-batch-099 totals are 969 answer-eligible families, 853 content-Verified families and 2,941 propositions; variance is recorded rather than hidden.
